purpose: Evaluate the archived R8 recipe as a per-fold rebuild, not by scoring its full-catalogue raster; compare predeclared cutoff/spacing/width/fusion alternatives with the historical BASE_topo_ridge local leader.

system_folds.construction: group 8-connected trace segments into systems by 8-px link dilation

segment_folds.construction: raw 8-connected pixel components, randomly grouped by pixel mass

protocol.known_fault_mask: pixel-exact visible catalogue mask; the 5-px buffer is removed from visible features but remains inside the evaluation domain and can accrue FP
protocol.scoring: local FoldScorer scores withheld truth only and masks prediction FP outside eval_mask; candidate maps are clipped to eval_mask
protocol.concealed_subset: withheld truth pixels in the valid-footprint slope bottom third; proxy stress test only
protocol.candidate_selection: threshold static scores at config coverage times full valid-pixel count, restricted to each fold's eval_mask; then apply grid decimation

scorer_verification.note: Float32 FoldScorer matched the local float64 reference on 15 trials after applying the same conservative eval_mask clipping; this does not resolve private evaluator masked-prediction semantics.

masked_prediction_policy.policy: predictions outside eval_mask are discarded before TP and FP calculation
masked_prediction_policy.uncertainty: Organizer wording does not resolve whether predictions on exact masked known-fault pixels can contribute TP to nearby new truth; see knowledge/02_irregularities.md Q-1.

protocol.random_control: Candidate variants are compared using direct DTI on the same fold families. Candidate-to-chance ratios are not used or reported; this remains a local catalogue-recovery proxy, not a private-test estimate.

chance_metrics_status: NOT_REPORTED; prior analytic candidate-to-chance ratios were uncalibrated and are withdrawn.
